items.name: Levantamento Terra Snatch Grip (Pegada muito aberta)
items.equipment: Barra olímpica e anilhas; pegada snatch bem aberta, mãos próximas das mangas da barra
items.movement: Snatch-grip barbell deadlift from floor. Very wide overhand grip, hands outside knees near bar sleeves. Start crouched holding bar on floor, rise with neutral back, extend hips and knees to stand, lower under control to floor. Bar stays near shins and thighs.

items.name: Agachamento Acima da Cabeça (Overhead Squat)
items.equipment: Barra olímpica livre mantida acima da cabeça, pegada larga
items.movement: Overhead barbell squat. Bar locked overhead throughout ALL frames, elbows straight, wide grip. Start standing, squat down with heels planted and bar balanced over midfoot, reach comfortable depth, rise standing. Arms stay straight, no shoulder press.

items.name: Agachamento Jefferson (Barra entre as pernas)
items.equipment: Barra reta com anilhas passando entre as pernas, uma perna de cada lado da barra
items.movement: Jefferson deadlift/Jefferson squat. Straddle a free barbell so bar runs between legs; one foot IN FRONT of the bar and the other BEHIND it. Grip bar with one hand in front of torso and one behind. Bend hips/knees to lower bar, then stand lifting bar between legs. Fixed stance, neutral back. No conventional front-of-both-legs deadlift.

items.name: Agachamento Sumô no Smith
items.equipment: Smith Machine; barra nas costas; base sumô bem aberta com pontas dos pés voltadas para fora
items.movement: Wide-stance sumo squat in Smith machine. Feet wide, toes turned outward, bar on upper back moving in vertical rails. Squat with knees tracking toes, then stand. Heels and stance fixed.

items.name: Agachamento Hack com Barra Livre (Barra por trás das pernas)
items.equipment: Barra livre reta com anilhas segurada ATRÁS das pernas; sem máquina
items.movement: FREE BARBELL hack squat. Stand holding a barbell behind thighs, both arms straight. Squat down with bar BEHIND lower legs near calves, then rise with bar behind thighs. This is NOT a machine hack squat, no apparatus. Bar stays behind body at every phase.

items.name: Afundo Estático com Barra Livre (Split Squat)
items.equipment: Barra livre nas costas; um pé à frente e outro atrás em base estática
items.movement: Static barbell split squat. Bar across upper back, staggered stance, feet NEVER step or change places. Lower rear knee toward floor by bending both knees, then extend to starting staggered stance. Whole bar and both feet visible.

items.name: Afundo Estático com Halteres
items.equipment: Dois halteres ao lado do corpo; um pé à frente e outro atrás, sem caminhar
items.movement: Static dumbbell split squat. One dumbbell hanging in each straight arm, staggered stance with front heel planted and rear heel raised. Lower rear knee toward floor then rise. Feet stay planted at fixed points; no walking or leg swap.

items.name: Agachamento Búlgaro com Barra Livre
items.equipment: Barra livre nas costas e banco baixo apoiando o peito do pé traseiro
items.movement: BARBELL Bulgarian split squat. Barbell on upper back, rear foot instep on bench, front foot on floor. Lower hips vertically by flexing front knee, rear knee moves toward floor, rise. Barbell, not dumbbells. Bench and contact feet fixed.

items.name: Subida no Banco com Barra
items.equipment: Caixa ou banco estável à frente do atleta; barra livre nas costas
items.movement: Barbell step-up onto box. Bar on upper back. Start with working foot fully planted atop box and other foot on floor behind. Drive through foot on box until standing high on that leg; trailing foot rises beside it, then lower trailing foot back to floor. Working foot stays atop box throughout. Keep box stationary.

items.name: Step-up Lateral na Caixa
items.equipment: Caixa ou step firme ao LADO do atleta, sem pesos
items.movement: LATERAL box step-up, bodyweight. Stand beside box with nearest foot on box and other on floor. Extend elevated leg lifting body vertically to box height, then lower outer foot to floor. Body faces camera, box stays at side. Not a forward step-up.

items.name: Agachamento Pistol (Unilateral com peso do corpo)
items.equipment: Peso corporal, sem banco, sem apoio e sem equipamento
items.movement: Unassisted PISTOL squat. Balance on ONE foot, other leg straight forward and off floor, arms extended forward. Squat deeply on support leg while nonworking leg stays straight in front. Rise to standing single-leg stance. No chair, no wall, no TRX. Whole extended leg in each tile.

items.name: RDL em Base Assimétrica (B-Stance RDL com Barra ou Halteres)
items.equipment: Barra livre; base B-stance com um pé principal à frente e pé de apoio ligeiramente atrás na ponta
items.movement: B-STANCE Romanian deadlift with barbell. Main foot flat, kickstand foot just behind with heel clearly lifted and only toes touching floor. Hold bar in front with straight arms. Hinge hips backward with soft knees, bar down close to front shin, then extend hips. Staggered stance stays fixed; not single-leg airborne RDL.

items.name: RDL na Polia Baixa
items.equipment: Polia BAIXA à frente, barra curta nas mãos, cabo vindo da base diante do atleta
items.movement: Romanian deadlift FACING low cable tower, short straight bar attachment in hands in front. Straight arms, slight knee bend. Hinge hips backward to lower hands toward shins, return standing. Cable from front low pulley stays taut to hands, NOT through legs, not cable pull-through.

items.name: Bom Dia no Smith
items.equipment: Smith Machine com barra apoiada nas costas
items.movement: Smith-machine GOOD MORNING. Bar rests on upper back throughout, held by hands. Feet fixed and knees only slightly soft. Hinge torso forward at hips with straight neutral back, bar descends with shoulders within rails, then extend hips to upright. Not a squat, not a deadlift, bar never held in front of thighs.

items.name: Bom Dia com Barra de Segurança (SSB Good Morning)
items.equipment: Barra de segurança SSB com yoke acolchoado e alças frontais; sem máquina
items.movement: GOOD MORNING with SAFETY SQUAT BAR. Padded yoke on upper back/shoulders, hands on FRONT handles. Feet fixed, knees slightly soft, hinge torso forward at hips with neutral back then return upright. Safety bar remains on shoulders. No squat or machine.

items.name: Elevação Pélvica com Halter ou Kettlebell
items.equipment: Banco apoiando escápulas; um halter deitado horizontalmente sobre o quadril
items.movement: Bilateral dumbbell HIP THRUST on bench. Upper back/scapulae on bench, both feet flat floor, one heavy dumbbell horizontal on padded pelvis held by both hands. Lower pelvis then extend hips until torso and thighs horizontal, lower again. Bench and feet fixed. Not unilateral, not floor-only bridge.

items.name: Frog Pump (Ponte de glúteo com solas dos pés unidas)
items.equipment: Colchonete; pés em posição borboleta com solas unidas e joelhos abertos
items.movement: FROG PUMP glute bridge. Lie supine on mat, soles of feet pressed TOGETHER, knees open outward in butterfly, heels near pelvis. Lift pelvis into short glute bridge while shoulders stay on floor, lower. Feet soles remain together, knees remain open. No weights or bench.

items.name: Elevação Pélvica com Pés Elevados no Banco
items.equipment: Banco baixo sob AMBOS os calcanhares; ombros apoiados no chão
items.movement: Bilateral glute bridge with FEET ELEVATED on bench. Shoulders and upper back remain on FLOOR/mat, both heels rest atop a low bench. Start hips low, lift pelvis until torso and thighs align, lower. Bench stays under feet, NEVER under shoulders. No barbell.

items.name: Desenvolvimento Alternado Sentado com Halteres
items.equipment: Banco com encosto a 85° e dois halteres
items.movement: ALTERNATING seated dumbbell shoulder press. Athlete seated with back supported. Both dumbbells initially at shoulders. Press left dumbbell overhead while right stays at shoulder, lower left, press right overhead while left stays at shoulder, lower right. SAME athlete, both feet and bench fixed. Never raise both together.

items.name: Push Press com Barra (Desenvolvimento com impulso das pernas)
items.equipment: Barra livre à frente dos ombros, pegada de desenvolvimento
items.movement: BARBELL PUSH PRESS. Start standing bar at front shoulders. Small knee/hip dip, explosive leg extension drives bar overhead, reach overhead standing with straight legs, lower bar to shoulders, return start. Dip must be shallow, not deep squat. Bar stays in front of head.

items.name: Z-Press (Desenvolvimento sentado no chão com pernas estendidas à frente)
items.equipment: Barra livre; atleta sentado DIRETAMENTE no chão com ambas as pernas estendidas à frente
items.movement: Barbell Z-PRESS. Sit directly on floor, both legs straight forward, heels on floor. No bench, no chair, knees never bend. Press bar from front shoulders overhead then lower. Torso upright and pelvis stays floor, no leg drive. Full feet and overhead bar inside tile.

items.name: Desenvolvimento com Kettlebell de Cabeça para Baixo (Bottoms-up KB Press)
items.equipment: Um kettlebell segurado INVERTIDO por uma mão, base pesada acima da alça; em pé
items.movement: Single-arm BOTTOMS-UP kettlebell overhead press. Standing. Hand grips handle; the round HEAVY BELL BODY is ABOVE the hand and handle, balanced upside-down, throughout every pose. Start hand near shoulder, press vertically overhead, lower to shoulder. Bell must NEVER hang below hand. Other arm relaxed, wrist aligned, feet fixed.

items.name: Rosca Arrasto com Barra ou no Smith (Drag Curl - cotovelos vão para trás)
items.equipment: Barra livre reta à frente das coxas, pegada supinada
items.movement: Barbell DRAG CURL. Stand with palms forward underhand grip. Curl by sliding bar closely UP the front of torso from thighs toward lower chest while elbows travel BACK behind body. Bar never arcs forward like normal curl. Lower with bar sliding down close to torso. Feet and torso fixed.

items.name: Rosca Garçom (Waiter's Curl - segurando a cabeça de um único halter com as duas mãos)
items.equipment: Um único halter vertical sustentado pela cabeça superior com ambas as palmas voltadas para cima
items.movement: WAITER'S CURL. One single dumbbell held VERTICAL in front of torso, BOTH cupped palms support UNDERSIDE of the UPPER dumbbell head, fingers facing up, do not grip central handle. Lower dumbbell below waist then flex elbows bringing upper head toward chest, lower. Dumbbell stays vertical; bottom head hangs below hands. Not two dumbbells or goblet squat.

items.name: Rosca com Anilha (Plate Curl)
items.equipment: Uma anilha redonda segurada pelas bordas com as duas mãos
items.movement: PLATE CURL. One round weight plate held at left/right edges by both hands, plate vertical in front. Flex elbows to bring plate from thighs to chest then lower. Upper arms stable next to torso, neutral wrists. No dumbbell, no barbell, no squat.
